svg.text: Front plate PL 12x180x335, flush with the face
template for the rods + bearing plate
fillets 8 on the flanges, 5 on the web, both sides
behind the far column bars and the far tie
2 rods 5/8" B7 over the top flange (|v| = 40)
nuts on both faces of both plates, L = 466
in the compression zone: shear only
rods of the steel column: 4 Ø12
VCM: 5 Ø12 top bars, hooked down
4 layers of 4 straight ties Ø10, as planned
closed tie Ø10 at +50, placed after the rods
Column top hooks along this beam;
the two at v = 0 side by side
deck notched around the end plate
